quote: The Bay of Bengal is hit frequently by cyclones. The months of November and May, in particular, are dangerous in this regard.
author: Abdul Kalam

quote: We Make Up Horrors To Help Us Cope With The Real Ones.
author: Stephen King

quote: Being The Richest Man In The Cemetery Doesn'T Matter To Me. Going To Bed At Night Saying We'Ve Done Something Wonderful, That'S What Matters To Me.

quote: I'll destroy you. I am the master of disaster.

quote: Lead such a life, that, when you die, the people may mourn you, and while you are alive they long for your company.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

quote: We Make War That We May Live In Peace.
author: Aristotle
